cookie.title: Cookies and analytics
cookie.body: Your language choice is stored on this device. We use analytics only if you agree.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What information this site handles, and how it is used.
privacy.p1: This site collects public information about international exchange in Nagaoka. You can browse without giving a name or email address.
privacy.p2: Your language choice is stored on your device (localStorage). It is not sent to a server.
privacy.p3: This site has no input fields. There is no point at which you send us a name, an email address or similar details.
privacy.p4: Analytics (Google Analytics) run only after you accept cookies. Refusing them does not change how you browse the site.
privacy.p5: Contact details of groups and events come from information those groups already publish. This site does not mediate on their behalf.
privacy.p6: We will update this page when the policy changes.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: The terms for using this site.
terms.p1: Listings are based on public sources and submissions from operators and groups. If something changes, follow the host’s own announcement.
terms.p2: The site operators are not responsible for participation, applications, or incidents at venues.
terms.p3: Copyright in text and photos belongs to the respective rights holders. Please do not redistribute without permission.
terms.p4: You may not copy the site’s structure or design for another service without permission.
terms.p5: Unlawful use, or use that harms others, is not allowed.
terms.p6: We may change or pause the site without notice.
